narrative_and_headings.usage: NPC dialogues, story text, game over screen, main menu options

ui_and_stats.usage: Card stats, health indicators, deck count, UI buttons

visual_effects.crt_overlay: Fixed screen-size div with pointer-events-none. CSS: `background: linear-gradient(rgba(18, 16, 16, 0) 50%, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25) 50%); background-size: 100% 2px;`
visual_effects.vignette: Fixed screen-size div. CSS: `background: radial-gradient(circle at center, transparent 40%, rgba(0,0,0,0.95) 120%); pointer-events: none;`
visual_effects.film_grain: CSS noise/SVG filter applied subtly across the background to give a gritty texture.
visual_effects.glitch_animations: Keyframes alternating X/Y translation by 1-2px and rapid opacity shifts for critical moments or Shadow World transitions.
visual_effects.pixel_art_rendering: Apply `image-rendering: pixelated;` to all SVG graphics and game containers to enforce sharp, retro aesthetics.

layout_and_spaces.global: Asymmetric, dark, focused on negative space.
layout_and_spaces.safe_environment: Stable CSS Grid layouts, slower transitions, slightly warmer surface tones (#15161A), calm breathing animations on selected elements.
layout_and_spaces.shadow_world: Jittery, distorted layouts. Cooler, abyssal background (#020203), harsh red accents, sudden glitch micro-animations.
layout_and_spaces.battle_board: 2 rows (Enemy vs Player). 4 slots each. Diegetic perspective: use CSS `perspective` and `rotateX` to make the board feel like it's resting on a physical table in front of the player.

cards.structure: HTML/SVG based (NO external images). Render pixel art icons using SVG `<rect>` elements or CSS grid painting.
cards.style: Dark border (#2A2C38), bone-white text, deep abyssal background. Stats distinctly placed at bottom corners.
cards.interactions: On hover, card tilts up `transform: perspective(600px) rotateX(10deg) translateY(-10px) scale(1.05)`. Fast, snappy ease-out.

npc_dialogue.style: Visual Novel text box at bottom. Typewriter effect (reveal letter by letter). Special Elite font.
npc_dialogue.indicator: Blinking cursor `_` or pulsing pixel block at the end of text.

buttons.style: Text-based with brackets (e.g., `> PLAY <`) or diegetic carved rectangles. Hover triggers text-shadow glow (`text-shadow: 0 0 8px #8A251C;`) or subtle X-axis jitter.

map_nodes.style: SVG circles/diamonds connected by jagged SVG paths. Current node pulses slowly.

media_and_assets.images: FORBIDDEN. User specifically requested 'Pixel art gerada via CSS/SVG (sem imagens externas)'. All visuals must be code-generated.
media_and_assets.audio: Synthesized via Web Audio API (as requested). Implement low frequency oscillators (LFO) for ambient hums and sharp square waves for glitches.

accessibility_and_testing.data_testid: CRITICAL: All interactive elements (cards, menu options, dialogue next buttons, save toggles) MUST have a kebab-case `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid='card-slot-1'`, `data-testid='start-run-button'`).

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the application in React using .js/.jsx files (no TypeScript as per environment setup).
Use Tailwind CSS for styling, extending the theme with the colors and fonts defined above.
Include Google Fonts 'Special Elite' and 'VT323' in the public index.html or via next/font if applicable.
Create a global Wrapper component that renders the CRT scanlines and vignette above all children.
Implement the state toggle between 'Safe Environment' and 'Shadow World' via a React Context that switches a CSS class on the root element, altering global CSS variables.
Strictly generate card artwork using SVG primitive shapes (rects, polygons) mimicking pixel art. Do not use tags with external sources.
Ensure the Battle Board uses CSS 3D transforms (`perspective`, `rotateX`) to look like a physical playing surface.
Verify all functional interactions (clicks, hovers) are trackable via `data-testid`.
